name: Burning, Crackling
source:
Nero is burning his drawings and sketchbooks after he received the news that he failed to enter his dream university. Fortunately, his best friend, Jin, comes just in time to stop his dumbass friend.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/burning-crackling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尼禄收到未能进入梦想大学的消息后，正在烧毁他的画作和素描本。幸运的是，他最好的朋友金及时赶来阻止了他的蠢朋友。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/burning-crackling]itch.io[/url]]
